description: Resolves the relative-time formatter for a component: the registered ITmRelativeTimeFormatter when AddTempoBlazor() ran (so a host can replace it), otherwise a default TmRelativeTimeFormatter over the component's ITmLocalizer and the registered TimeProvider. Never throws for a missing registration. Public so split packages use this one resolver instead of copying the fallback.

members.name: Resolve
members.description: Returns the formatter to render a relative-time stamp with: the one registered in services when present, otherwise a default TmRelativeTimeFormatter over the given localizer and the registered TimeProvider (the system clock when none is). Never throws for a missing registration.
